priceListMeta.title: PRICE LIST 2026 No. 71 cn Z3, GB
priceListMeta.valid: Valid from 01.01.2026 until revoked for United Kingdom
priceListMeta.pricesNote: Prices are in GBP and include transport cost to the dealer's warehouse; **recommended retail price GBP incl. VAT and shipping costs

coloursNote: Interior always grey white (price list p2). No metallic silver for the building itself; the sectional overhead door is silver only.
sellingPoints: Individually configured to suit your requirements
Elegant design – modern flat roof, no screws visible on the exterior walls
Maintenance-free for life - 20-year guarantee subject to Biohort’s warranty terms and conditions
Produced individually in line with the customer's requirements.
Easy to heat thanks to thermal insulation. U value of side walls: 0.76 W/(m2K)
Door hinge can be positioned on the right or left to suit you
Wide range of accessories for interior fittings
Ventilation via acrylic glass skylight, which can be opened
Comfortable door opening with gas spring
locking mechanism complete with stainless steel door handle
Roof and snow load of up to 215 kg/m2 (less roof loading such as greenery, for instance)

Top quality materials: Extruded aluminium sections and sandwich elements made from galvanised, polyamide enamel coated steel plate with an insulated core of 40 mm polystyrene (EPS20), screws and hinges made from stainless steel
High stability: Roof load up to 215 kg/m² less roof loading such as greenery, storm-proof (up to 150 km/h, wind force 12)* (* with professional assembly and anchoring)
No screws visible on the external walls
guarantee: 20-year guarantee subject to Biohort’s warranty terms and conditions (product page); terms www.biohort.com/terms-of-guarantee (price list p1). Earlier research recorded moving/electrical/plastic/rubber parts as 24-month statutory warranty (from the published terms; not re-checked today).
delivery: Web: "Free Shipping within 6 weeks". Price list p1: "Delivery time: within 4–6 weeks upon order clarity"; delivery to the dealer's warehouse, dealer arranges delivery to the end customer; Biohort checks on request whether end-customer delivery is possible; 38-t lorry access (3 m width); fixed delivery dates only with additional cost.
steelThickness: ≥ 0,50 mm steel plate, each side ≥ 7 µm galvanised + 1 µm pre-treatment + 5 µm primer + ≥ 20 µm polyamide enamel coating (price list p1). Sandwich wall element with 40 mm polystyrene core (EPS W20), U-value 0.76 W/(m2K).
roof: Flat roof, 1° pitch (web FAQ); roof/snow load up to 215 kg/m2 less roof loading such as greenery; 2 roof drains with rainwater downpipes; roof overhang 140 mm (web FAQ table); 360° acrylic glass skylight which can be opened for ventilation (optional double-glazed version without ventilation).
standardFeaturesPriceList: Insulated sandwich elements with a polystyrene core (EPS 20, 40 mm), U-value 0.76 W/(m2K)
Locking mechanism with stainless steel door handle
Door hinge position on the left or right available
Roof resp. snow load of up to 215 kg/m2 (less roof loading such as greenery)
Ventilation via acrylic glass panel which can be opened
Screws and anchors for mounting to the foundation

notes: Converted from the earlier research on branch wip/codex-v2-2026-10-13 (docs/sources/catalogue.json) and re-verified on 13 Oct 2026 against the current GB page (JSON-LD offers, data sheet) and Endkundenpreisliste_cn_GB.pdf (version dated 17 Dec 2025 in PDF metadata). Every base price and every priced accessory in the earlier work matches the current price list.
9 sizes x 2 door hinges x 2 colours = 36 SKUs, all priced on the GB page and identical to the price list. Right- and left-hinge variants cost the same.

The web data sheet lists only the right-hinge EANs; left-hinge SKUs come from the price list and brochure and are confirmed by JSON-LD offers and the page's "Right door hinge / Left door hinge" option.
CasaNova accessories are not embedded in the GB product page HTML (no "Matching accessories" data found); they are sold via the Roomle configurator. All accessory prices here are from the price list.
Size code is nominal metres (W x L).
